events.line: Rob just benched a guy who put up 27.5 fucking points—that's not fantasy football, that's fantasy fiction, and you wrote the worst ending possible.

Adam sat Drake Maye on the bench and watched him put up 26.2 points from his couch like a fucking idiot—that's what happens when you panic bench your QB after one bad week instead of having some goddamn conviction.

Jetmir, you absolute madman—McMillan just put up 38 fucking points and you're gonna get all the credit for having the stones to start him when literally nobody else believed, but let's be honest, that was pure luck and we both know it.

Rinor, you absolute coward—Doubs just dropped 20.8 points on your fucking bench while you were out there sweating your starter, and now you get to watch him blow up in someone else's lineup next week because you chickened out on a guy who was clearly due.

Flamur benched Keon Coleman and watched him go off for 20.6 points from the fucking couch—that's what happens when you panic-bench your receivers like you're playing hot potato instead of fantasy football.

Rob, what the fuck were you doing with Kyren on the bench all season when he decided to go full apeshit mode THIS week—31.7 points, nearly triple his projection, and of course it happens when you finally grew a pair and started him.

CeeDee just put up 32.8 points and made Flamur look like a goddamn genius for once—too bad that confidence won't last more than five minutes before he panic trades him for a backup tight end next week.
Jetmir, you absolute coward—benching a guy who just put up 17 points when you projected him for 8 is the kind of chickenshit panic move that's gonna haunt you when you lose by 6 this week.
Nori actually fucking nailed it this week—Williams went absolutely bonkers and more than doubled his projection, so congrats on having the balls to trust him when nobody else did.
Veton actually had the balls to start Collins and watch him go absolutely nuclear, pulling off the most accidental genius move of the season—even a blind squirrel finds a nut sometimes, I guess.
